thermal: No thermal/performance warning, CPU limits absent or 100 percent; AC power required
mode: controls_then_smoke; evaluation is separately invoked with --evaluate after successful controls
evaluation_exposure: All 30 #72 evaluation cases already exposed by #74; not a pristine holdout
execution: Rust preview only; no approval or RDF execution command; no #75 integration
decision: INCONCLUSIVE_REVISE until both models/stages, all controls and independently approved answer evidence meet #74 thresholds; no accuracy ranking from missing outputs
supersedes_control_variant: v1d unchanged; complete JSON equality remains its original gate.
hypothesis: Combined language presentation + semantic repeatability interpretation; exposed regression only, no causal ablation or model ranking.
controls_before_smoke: Fail closed at first failed control. Generic every-stored-label question may clarify because multiple original label predicates exist; explicit rdfs:label injection control must match its reference. All configured missing checks remain unattempted.
scoring: Keep exact frozen-reference fields and model status separate from preregistered acceptable ambiguity. No change to #74 scoring or thresholds. Stable wrong plans remain wrong. Rationale claims manually reviewed against graph-qualified source without query execution.
scope_policy: Original evaluation snapshot, policy and scope only; oracle first; frozen whole-question BM25-v1 separate, no neighborhood substitution
source_evidence: Same authorized source edges and collisions as v1d; source names grouped by original language, predicate IRI local names extracted mechanically. No translations, invented property definitions, selected IDs or gold directions.

repeatability.gate: Strict Rust-accepted drafts, identical prompt/token/request identities, equal model status and, for candidates, exact start/predicate/graph/direction/output. Stable abstention has no plan and is not semantic success.

rationale_review.method: Post-generation AI investigator review of every non-sampling rationale; retain exact text, individual factual/cross-graph claims, supported/unsupported/unverifiable classification and source evidence. No automatic clean-rationale claim and no independent human review.
rationale_review.gate: Any unsupported assertion prevents GO; unverifiable or unreviewed claims prevent GO. Prose differences alone do not stop the run.
